name: TAXONOMY_DISCOVERY
reopened_by: own finding: FY2024 ESEF taxonomy inferred as 'analogous', not observed; the 6 real iXBRL components not analysed
findings: IPP taxonomy version uniform: 2019-01-01 (Circular 3/2018) across the corpus.
IPP model families: SAN/BBVA = ipp_en (entidades/credit model), IBE = ipp_ge (general model). Structural difference discoverable from namespace/schemaRef, not issuer name.
H1 vs H2 falsified: same taxonomy for both; H2 small size is fewer facts, not a different taxonomy (SAN H2-2025 uses ipp_en/2019-01-01).
ESEF: the downloaded ?e= artefact is the cover page (no ix:/schemaRef). The inline-XBRL report and the ZIP/Xbri package are separate components.

ESEF consolidated iXBRL schemaRef (FY2025) -> issuer extension taxonomy: SAN=http://www.santander.com/20251231/5493006QMFDDMYWIAM13-2025-12-31.xsd, BBVA=http://www.bbva.es/20251231/K8MS7FD7N5Z2WQ51AZ71-2025-12-31.xsd, IBE=http://www.iberdrola.com/20251231/5QK37QC7NWOJ8D7WVQ45-2025-12-31.xsd.

ESEF iXBRL requires the issuer extension taxonomy + the ESMA ESEF base taxonomy package; the cover XHTML alone is insufficient for offline reconstruction -> ZIP/Xbri package (extension taxonomy) is a required dependency for R10.
Content sniffing used, never the file extension; raw files are .zip-named but IPP=XML, ESEF=XHTML.
limitations: FAIL: only FY2025 ESEF schemaRefs observed; FY2024 was inferred as 'analogous' (20241231) rather than observed. The real iXBRL components for all 6 ESEF filings (incl. FY2024) must be analysed before R9 can pass.
